data.name: Abjuration Opposition School
data.description: You have chosen abjuration spells as an opposition school. Preparing an abjuration spell takes up two spell slots of the same level. You take a -4 penalty on any skill checks made when crafting a magic item that has an abjuration spell as a prerequisite.
